verdict.rationale: Brevo documents a built-in assistant, Aura AI, that answers plain-language questions about your data. It also offers in-product AI help that summarizes live chats, tailors replies and polishes notes into messages. These are question-answering and writing aids rather than delegation of multi-step tasks. The MCP and ChatGPT/Claude integrations are external AI tools, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence that the built-in assistant can take actions on the user's behalf (e.g. build campaigns, segments or workflows), documentation of Aura's scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Ask plain‑language questions and get instant answers from your data with Aura AI.
Summarize live chats in one click, tailor replies to your tone, and turn quick notes into polished messages
